main_text.l: aufim ut id faciat eam exhortari : nisi
enim remedium illud à sede Apostolica
exoriatur, nulla spes est, ut aliunde prc[?]-
certis de causis sit difficile, illius libri
censuram edere non possunt nisi singuli,
at qui probabile fiet Episcopi unius Cen-
am, qui à celeberrima Societate testimon-
cancer iste, sed longis passibus gradit-
& depascitur; si hæresim prima fronte disseminaret liber ille, parvum hinc aut fere nullum damnum
nunc temporis emergeret ; omnes enim Catholici librum hunc libriq; autorem ut aspidem
nec in quem illud cum efficacia ejacularetur,

page.notes: Doubtful: "prc" in "ut aliunde prc-veniat" is probably "pro" (proveniat), printed with a misformed letter, so I kept the letters as seen and marked them. The word "ejacularetur" has a damaged "r" and is read with some doubt. Spellings are normalised for u/v and i/j as specified (qui, quem, omniaque, unius, ut). Printed spelling otherwise kept, including "remedium,non" and the spaces before ":" and "?". The page ends mid-sentence and the paragraph continues on the next page.
